DB cleaned and Bosch Excel re-uploaded (442 offers extracted, 105 SKU-matched to products in 0.47s). Both reported bugs are fully fixed on real Bosch data.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 root cause: in offers_for_product, the previous $or branch matched any offer with same brand/category — offers that had a SKU but empty product_ids (SKU not in catalog) leaked to unrelated products. Fix (verified): non_sku_filter requires `sku==null OR missing OR ''` AND `product_ids missing OR []` for the brand/category fallback branch. Bug 2 root cause: `_col_index(headers, 'bank')` incorrectly matched the 'Remarks (Banks...)' column header which held EMI terms text. Fix (verified): dedicated `idx_terms` targets 'remarks (banks' / 'remarks (other banks' headers for terms; valid_bank extracted from the legend row above the header ('All Banks'); new `tenure` column extracted separately.
